drift_note: origin/main had not advanced past the pinned base SHA at any point this lane checked it. This lane never fetched or absorbed later main regardless.
bootstrap_deviation: ROOT is a shallow local clone, so 'git clone --reference-if-able ROOT --no-checkout UPSTREAM_URL LANE_REPO' silently degraded (reference repository is shallow) and fell back to a full network clone that did not complete inside a 2-minute tool timeout. ROOT was confirmed to already have base_sha reachable locally with a clean working tree, so the bootstrap instead ran 'git clone --no-checkout ROOT LANE_REPO' (fast, local, no network) followed by 'git remote set-url origin UPSTREAM_URL' so the lane's remote identity is still the real upstream, not ROOT. Content at base_sha is byte-identical either way. Recorded in $LANE_ROOT/WORKLOG.md.
